confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant and beer anchors rest on aggregated Ljubljana price guides (Numbeo-derived Combien-coute figures, Expatistan, Mylifeelsewhere) of mixed dates, and one Expatistan beer figure is from 2024. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker: they come from bar-guide ranges and a travel blog, with cocktail set near the low-middle of the 9 to 15 EUR range. Accommodation anchors (dorm, private hostel, 1-star, 3-star) are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Ljubljana's July demand; no booking pages or current listings were inspected, so they carry the widest uncertainty. EUR values were converted at about 1.14 USD per EUR, the rate implied by a cited conversion, not a live rate check. The FX search summary reported 0.6947 for 16 October 2026 and 0.6955 for 15 October 2026; the 16 October figure is used, but the RBA page should be checked because the two dates conflicted.
comparable_city_reasoning: Ljubljana-specific aggregated price guides for food and drink, converted from EUR to USD. Accommodation is based on general knowledge of mid-sized Central European capitals with comparable summer tourist demand, adjusted for Ljubljana's pricing level.
